request.style: English, heartfelt acoustic country, warm female vocal with light twang, acoustic guitar, dobro, fiddle, upright bass, brushed drums, nostalgic and trusting, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mama kept her Bible on the windowsill by the sink
Pages soft as flour sacks and underlined in pencil ink
She said, child, when the road forks and you don't know where to go
There's a word I want you holding more than anything you know

[Chorus]
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
And do not lean on your own understanding
In all your ways acknowledge him
And he will make your paths straight

[Verse]
I've been lost on county highways with a map across my knee
Sure that I was smart enough to find the way for me
But the roads I chose kept winding and the dust got in my eyes
Till I pulled off on the shoulder and I let go of my pride

[Chorus]
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
And do not lean on your own understanding
In all your ways acknowledge him
And he will make your paths straight

[Bridge]
Do not be wise in your own eyes
Fear the LORD and turn away from evil
Bind them around your neck
Write them on the tablet of your heart

[Chorus]
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
And do not lean on your own understanding
In all your ways acknowledge him
And he will make your paths straight

[Outro]
He will make your paths straight
Mama, I still hear you say
